description: This file defines the ServerRequestInterface interface within the PSR HTTP Message standard, describing the structure and methods for representing an immutable server-side HTTP request, including access to server parameters, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, request body, and attributes.

methods.name: getServerParams
methods.description: Retrieve server parameters, typically derived from $_SERVER.

methods.name: getCookieParams
methods.description: Retrieve cookies sent by the client.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Return a new instance with specified cookies, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Return a new instance with specified query parameters.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Return a new instance with specified uploaded files.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Retrieve parameters from the request body.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Return a new instance with specified parsed body data.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieve a single attribute with optional default.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Return a new instance with a specified attribute.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Return a new instance without a specified attribute.
